scope: Optional private full-validator warm-restart preparation with synthetic processes and RPC observations; no actual validator or network execution

localValidation.skipReason: Actual Linux process-name fixture requires Linux

checks: Default and read-only modes cannot execute the optional restart
Invalid node or missing/dead/duplicate ownership refuses before a stop
Original process exit must be observed without forced or abnormal termination
Only connection refusal proves selected endpoint unavailable; replies/timeouts/malformed responses refuse
Surviving node processes, genesis and identities must remain selected
Replacement must be distinct and registered in outer cleanup ownership
Changed bundle, runtime bytes or original ledger genesis refuse before replacement
Integrated synthetic restart uses identical original/replacement command and only three initial ledger materializations
All nine vote/root views, unchanged stake and earlier finalized history are required after restart
Stalls, child exits, ambiguous progress and cancellation cannot become acceptance
All synthetic children are cleaned after both successful and rejected launcher paths
remainingRequirements: Capable Linux host and actual fresh hashing genesis/startup replays
Actual three-full-validator consensus and optional warm restart
Separate cold restore, hard-crash, fork and quorum-limit drills
Independent operators, funded backing, custody, security and release review
